answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development release readiness and supports runtime_permission_enforcement, controlled_workspace_tools, and subtask_orchestration by closing a required-before-release controlled tool execution authority module-decomposition slice.
answers.new_capability: The runtime now has a cohesive controlled_tool_execution Rust module boundary for existing tool.list/tool.plan/tool.intent.parse/tool.execute handlers, tool result shaping, verification completion gates, tool-intent events, workspace-write proposal admission, and subtask dispatch evidence helpers.

answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Product completion cannot safely converge while controlled workspace tools, verifier gates, and subtask dispatch evidence remain mixed with unrelated runtime responsibilities in the monolith.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M64.12 LLM Provider Runtime Boundary, M64.13 Headless Journey Drive Orchestration, and M64.14 Headless Continue Orchestration because this phase moves controlled tool execution and tool-derived ledger/subtask evidence authority rather than provider execution, journey-drive execution, or continuation routing.

answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, dashboard, inspection, or summary wrapper; existing result payloads are preserved.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Observable runtime behavior is intentionally preserved; the runtime implementation surface changes by moving controlled tool execution authority into a module boundary, with semantic equivalence verified by behavior tests.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Controlled tools, verifier gates, workspace proposal admission, and subtask dispatch evidence are the safety spine for long-running autonomous repair and continuation, and their ownership is now reviewable as a coherent runtime boundary.
answers.milestone_progress: Adds a fifteenth bounded partial closure of the authoritative runtime-module-decomposition required-before-release debt without claiming full debt resolution.
